scripts.clean: npm run clean:dist && npm run clean:logs
scripts.clean:logs: rm -f build.log full-build.log programmatic-webpack.log stats.json webpack-stats.json webpack-json.err webpack-stats.err || true
scripts.build: [ -e dist ] && [ ! -d dist ] && rm -f dist || true; mkdir -p dist && BABEL_ENV=production NODE_ENV=production npx webpack --stats=errors-warnings --no-color && echo '--- dist after webpack ---' && (ls -l dist || true) && if [ -f app/config.local.js ]; then cp -f app/config.local.js dist/; fi && cp -f app/recorder-worker.js dist/; bytes=$(stat -c %s dist/index.html 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$bytes" -le 5000 ]; then echo 'ERROR: dist/index.html not emitted or too small ('$bytes' bytes)'; exit 1; fi && echo 'Build OK'
scripts.build:verbose: [ -e dist ] && [ ! -d dist ] && rm -f dist || true; mkdir -p dist && npx webpack --progress --profile --color && if [ -f app/config.local.js ] && [ ! -f dist/config.local.js ]; then cp app/config.local.js dist/; fi && cp app/recorder-worker.js dist/
scripts.prepare: if [ -z "$SKIP_PREPARE" ]; then rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && npm run build; fi
